_comment: Emptied deliberately. This file previously held AcademicPages template filler -- 'Your Sidebar Name', 'GitHub University', 'Red Brick University' -- which was never Tobias's data. Nothing renders it: _includes/cv-template.html and _layouts/cv-layout.html exist but no page uses either, and the /cv-json/ nav entry is commented out in _config.yml. Kept as an empty object rather than deleted so site.data.cv resolves rather than being nil if something references it later. The real CV is the LaTeX source at C:\website\CV\CV_Tobias_Grossboelting.tex, published as files/CV_Tobias_Grossboelting.pdf; scripts/update_cv_json.sh would regenerate this file but is not part of the build.
